title: A New Neighbor at the Front Desk · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about a new person in your building. Use be verbs (am/is/are), one negative sentence, and one question. Example: This is my neighbor. She is not a teacher. Is she a student?
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
